prompt:
Build a 4-by-4 fixed-point, HDL-compatible streaming minimum-variance distortionless-response adaptive beamformer in Simulink. The model must estimate the sample covariance matrix, defined as one over 4096 times the outer-product sum over each 4096 valid array samples, apply the supplied positive diagonal loading, obtain and normalize a four-element adaptive weight vector for the supplied steering vector, and use those weights to form a single complex beamformed stream. The covariance, solve, normalization, weight, and beam-output operations must form one causally connected streaming path driven by the measured four-channel input; controller architecture, matrix-solution architecture, pipelining, and latency are otherwise unrestricted.

Read ArrayData, InputValid, SteeringVector, and DiagonalLoading from the MATLAB base workspace. ArrayData is an N-by-4 complex normalized-baseband array ordered element_1 through element_4, with row k presented at integer model-time tick k-1. InputValid provides one logical flag per row and can contain invalid gaps; invalid rows must not enter covariance accumulation, adaptation counts, or valid output claims. SteeringVector is a complex 4-by-1 column vector. DiagonalLoading is a real scalar from 0.002 to 0.015. Treat the supplied array samples as signed 16-bit fixed-point input data and preserve a fixed-point, HDL-compatible implementation through the adaptive beamforming path.

Log MATLAB Timeseries named BeamformedOutput, OutputValid, WeightVector, WeightValid, CovarianceMatrix, CovarianceValid, LoadedCovarianceMatrix, LoadedCovarianceValid, SolveVector, SolveValid, NormalizationState, and NormalizationValid. BeamformedOutput is one complex normalized-baseband channel paired with the one-channel logical OutputValid. WeightVector has 4 complex unitless channels [w1,w2,w3,w4] paired with WeightValid. CovarianceMatrix has 16 complex normalized-amplitude-squared channels in column-major order [R11,R21,R31,R41,R12,R22,R32,R42,R13,R23,R33,R43,R14,R24,R34,R44] paired with CovarianceValid. LoadedCovarianceMatrix uses the same 16-channel column-major order with RL entries and is paired with LoadedCovarianceValid. SolveVector has 4 complex unitless channels [u1,u2,u3,u4] paired with SolveValid. NormalizationState has 2 real unitless channels [steering inner product, reciprocal] paired with NormalizationValid. Each valid signal is one logical channel. Complex-valued signals must remain complex rather than being replaced by magnitudes. Every numeric Timeseries and its paired valid Timeseries must share the same Time vector; a true valid sample denotes a complete newly meaningful value, while data outside valid samples is ignored by the evaluator.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XCOMM02.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
